title: Edmund and the Portrait
author: Beatrix Dravenmoor
blurb: Dominic Dravenmoor, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent five years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
